harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory ownership and permissions on node1: created the missing inventorysvc service user and inventory-readers group, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, applied 750 on directories and 640 on files (owner rw, group r, others none), preserved all existing file contents, and functionally verified access (owner and group-member reads succeed, unrelated user is denied both directory listing and file read). Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, permissions, data), rebooted node1 via a backgrounded shutdown -r now so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just an idle wait), and re-verified post-restart that ownership, permissions, and file contents are all intact.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory current ownership/permissions and existing data on node1
Confirmed inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group did not exist
Created inventory-readers group and inventorysvc system user (uid/gid 993)
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod 750 on all directories, 640 on all files under /srv/inventory
Verified file contents unchanged (records.csv, config.json)
Functionally tested access: owner read OK, group-member read OK, unrelated user denied listing and reading
Removed temporary test users (reader_test, other_test) used only for the access verification, restoring inventory-readers membership to empty
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id and full permission/data state
Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' on node1 so the exec ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed from 4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4 to db9370b8-17eb-4dc2-8b12-1ed1c2be2ebd, proving a genuine restart
Re-verified post-restart that /srv/inventory ownership, permissions, and file contents remain correct and unchanged

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline: existing users/groups absent, original data present under root ownership before repair
evidence.summary: Showed /srv/inventory owned by root:root with world-readable files, and that inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group did not exist yet

evidence.requirement: Create inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group
evidence.summary: groupadd inventory-readers and useradd inventorysvc succeeded; id/getent confirm both exist (uid/gid 993, gid 1000)

evidence.requirement: Data owned by inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, correct permission bits, contents preserved
evidence.summary: chown -R and chmod applied; recursive listing shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership with drwxr-x--- (750) dirs and -rw-r----- (640) files

evidence.requirement: Contents preserved and access enforced correctly (owner/group can read, others cannot access)
evidence.summary: records.csv and config.json content unchanged; sudo -u inventorysvc and sudo -u reader_test (in inventory-readers) both read successfully; sudo -u other_test denied both file read and directory listing

evidence.requirement: Cleanup of temporary verification users, leaving only the required group/user state
evidence.summary: reader_test and other_test removed after killing their processes; inventory-readers group membership returned to empty

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: pre-restart baseline (boot id, healthy data/permissions)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4 plus full healthy /srv/inventory state and user/group facts before reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returning before disconnect, then confirmed unreachability mid-restart
evidence.summary: Backgrounded shutdown -r now returned 'reboot issued' immediately; subsequent exec calls timed out/reset, proving the node actually went down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving a genuine restart
evidence.summary: Exec became available again and boot_id changed to db9370b8-17eb-4dc2-8b12-1ed1c2be2ebd, different from the pre-restart value

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required data and permissions
evidence.summary: After restart, /srv/inventory ownership/permissions unchanged (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 750/640) and original file contents (records.csv, config.json) intact
